title: Uric acid metabolism and xanthine oxidase inhibition
abstract: Gout is caused by hyperuricemia leading to monosodium urate crystal deposition in joints. Xanthine oxidase (XO) is the key enzyme catalyzing uric acid synthesis, and its inhibition lowers serum urate levels.

title: NLRP3 inflammasome activation by urate crystals
abstract: Monosodium urate crystals activate the NLRP3 inflammasome in macrophages, leading to caspase-1 activation and release of active IL-1beta, causing acute inflammatory gouty arthritis.
